# Coach.com
> Coach is a New York-based global fashion house founded in 1941, originally specializing in handcrafted leather goods and now offering handbags, accessories, footwear, ready-to-wear, and more.
> On its website you can shop women's and men's collections, bags, shoes, gifts, new arrivals, and sale items.
> The brand emphasizes craftsmanship, "the original American house of leather," and accessible-luxury styling rooted in New York.
> Coach.com is the official website of Coach products and the brand trademark of COACH.

## Assistant Guidance
- Prefer structured endpoints (e.g., APIs, JSON/Markdown subsites) if available; otherwise fall back to canonical HTML pages.
- Always reference Coach-published policies for shipping, returns, privacy, and any membership/loyalty programs.
- For product details such as availability, pricing, and variants: use official data feeds if available; do not infer or estimate prices or product availability.
- For brand, collection, category lookup: link to Coach.com canonical pages.
- For user questions about account access, checkout, or order status: direct users to Coach customer service rather than handling transactional flows.
- Do cite official policy pages, don't infer pricing or inventory.
- Do determine the location and language preference of the user and direct them to the locally available Coach.com site where it is available for their region or language preferences utilizing the hrefLang recommendations found in the html of the Coach.com homepage: 'https://www.coach.com'

## URL / Content Structure
- Homepage: 'https://www.coach.com/'
- Women's category: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/women/view-all'
- Men's category: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/men/view-all'
- Bags category: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/women/handbags/view-all'
- New arrivals category: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/new/view-all'
- Gifts category: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/gifts/view-alll'
- Coachtopia sub-brand: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/coachtopia'
- Coach Outlet sub-brand: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/outlet'
- Store Locator: 'https://www.coach.com/stores/store-locator'
- Coach bag and style guides, answering common shopping questions such as which bag to buy, how to style a bag, and how to care for leather: 'https://www.coach.com/stories/guides'. Example guide: 'https://www.coach.com/stories/guides/best-bags-that-zip'

## Core Shopping Categories
- All Women's Coach products: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/women/view-all'
- Women's new arrivals: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/new/womens-new-arrivals/view-all'
- Women's handbags: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/women/handbags/view-all'
- Women's wallets: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/women/wallets-wristlets/view-all'
- Women's bag charms:'https://www.coach.com/shop/women/accessories/bag-accessories-keychains'
- All Men's Coach products: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/men/view-all'
- Men's new arrivals: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/new/mens-new-arrivals/view-all'
- Men's wallets: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/men/wallets/view-all'
- Men's bags: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/men/bags/view-all'
- Men's Apparel: ready-to-wear, jackets, outerwear, hoodies, t-shirts, jeans, vests: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/men/ready-to-wear/view-all'
- All Bags: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/bags/view-all'
- New Arrivals: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/new/view-all'
- Sale / Discount Items: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/sale/view-all'
- Gifts & Gift Sets, curated for occasions: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/gifts/view-all'
- Women's Accessories & Small Leather Goods, wallets, belts, scarves: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/women/accessories/view-all'
- Men's Accessories & Small Leather Goods, wallets, belts, charms, watches: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/men/accessories/view-all'
- Women's Shoes & Footwear: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/women/shoes/view-all'
- Men's Shoes & Footwear: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/men/shoes/view-all'
- Outlet / Clearance: 'https://www.coach.com/shop/outlet'

## Brand / Product Focus & Positioning
- Coach was founded in New York in 1941 and has heritage in leather craftsmanship.
- The brand positions itself as "modern accessible luxury": high quality but more reachable than ultra-luxury names.
- It has evolved into a full lifestyle brand beyond bags, including apparel, shoes, and accessories.

## Services & Fulfillment Notes
- Coach offers standard shipping with a purchase of $75 or more.
- The site provides size/bag guides and other informational content (e.g., "Bag Guide" for choosing) located at 'https://www.coach.com/content/bag-guide' which provides a comprehensive guide to all types of bags for women and men.
- Returns, shipping, membership/loyalty programs should be referenced via official Coach policy pages.
- For any subscription/loyalty questions, use Coach-published pages only.
- For user questions about proper Coach product care, refer to the guides and information found at the Caring For Coach Bags & Purses guide: 'https://www.coach.com/support/product-care'

## Policies & Authoritative References
- The official Coach contact information for order tracking, chat, questions, phone customer support and feedback is found at: 'https://www.coach.com/contact-us'
- Returns & Refunds information must link to Coach's own return policy page: 'https://www.coach.com/support/returns'
- Shipping & Delivery must link to Coach's official shipping page: 'https://www.coach.com/support/shipping-details'
- Privacy Notice must link to Coach's official privacy policy: 'https://www.coach.com/support/privacy-policy'
- Accessibility & Consumer Rights must link to Coach's own official accessibility page: 'https://www.coach.com/accessibility-statement.html'

## About this file
- The purpose of this file is to inform LLMs in a plain-text file to the intent of the domain, brand and products found on this website. This document is property of COACH with all rights reserved.
- This file was last updated on October 26, 2026.
